title: {Je me fais couper...} - {Service Phrases}
description: Talk about services and appointments! '{Je me fais couper les cheveux}' (I'm getting my hair cut), '{Je fais réparer ma voiture}' (I'm having my car repaired). Adult life essentials!

vocabulary.fr: je me fais couper les cheveux

concepts.term: Je me fais + verb = Getting Something Done TO YOU
concepts.definition: Services for yourself: haircut, makeup, medical exams, etc.
concepts.example: {Je me fais couper les cheveux} (I'm getting my hair cut - at salon)

concepts.term: Je fais + verb = Having Something Done (Not You)
concepts.definition: Having something repaired, built, cleaned by someone else
concepts.example: {Je fais réparer ma voiture} (I'm having my car repaired - by mechanic)

items.situation: Say you're getting your hair cut (salon appointment!)
items.answer: je me fais couper les cheveux

mistakes.feedback: That means YOU cut it yourself! At salon, use: je me fais couper les cheveux

items.situation: Say you're having your car repaired (at mechanic)

mistakes.feedback: That means YOU repair it! By mechanic, use: je fais réparer ma voiture

items.situation: Say you're getting your makeup done (makeup artist)
Say you're having the house cleaned (cleaning service)
Say you're having a house built (construction project)
